_about: The Slack channels the automations post in. They are made for the automations; nothing is ever posted in a client channel or a channel where people talk. Filled in by tab 3 (slack_setup.py make-channels). Change a name here, then run make-channels again and redeploy. Never put a token here.

new-tasks.name: new-tasks
new-tasks.posts: A new card on any board, a new client, a new form submitted

task-updates.name: task-updates
task-updates.posts: A card is ready for its maker, blocked or rejected

amendments.name: amendments
amendments.posts: A card is sent back for changes, with the notes in the thread

review.name: review
review.posts: A card is ready for someone to check

approved.name: approved
approved.posts: A card reaches its last stage

pipeline-errors.name: pipeline-errors
pipeline-errors.posts: Any failed automation, once a day at most

needs-a-person.name: needs-a-person
needs-a-person.posts: A card reaches a stage with nobody set to do it (once a day per card). A person with no Slack account linked is not posted here: the alert names them as plain text, and Step 5 links them
